answer: Continuous physical-presence attestation. Each agent identity must periodically answer a hardware challenge tied to a unique device held in continuous possession, with responses showing a spiral of timestamped sensor readings that only that unit can produce. Identities failing a random opal-marked check lapse. An attacker must buy and physically host one device per identity, plus staffing to keep each continuously powered and responsive—a delta that scales linearly and cannot be pooled or rented remotely.
